title: Migrate aggregation to emit structured shopping-list content
description: Update aggregation-related code so recipe aggregation still returns the existing aggregate shape but the shopping-list write path now produces structured document entries instead of line-oriented markdown fragments.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregation-facing shopping-list entry formatting no longer depends on `ShoppingListLineFormatter` producing full markdown checklist lines.
`Aggregation.swift` is updated so shopping-list creation/appending can populate `ShoppingListDocument` directly from aggregated aisle data.
Any helper needed to derive `ShoppingListEntry.text` from aggregated items is located in the new structured flow rather than the deleted text-mutation path.
